title: Jamaican Pork Skewers with Zesty Glaze
description: Sweet and spicy Jamaican pork skewers marinated in a zesty glaze, perfect for a summer barbecue.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together jerk seasoning, lime juice, honey, soy sauce, and garlic.
Add the pork cubes to the marinade and mix until they are evenly coated.
Thread the marinated pork onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with the zesty glaze and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the pork is cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with crispy onion and fresh cilantro.
To make the zesty glaze, whisk together the ingredients in a small bowl until smooth.
Adjust the seasoning as needed and brush the glaze over the skewers during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
